summary: The argument is mathematically complete. The half-metronoids are correctly shown to be full-dimensional centrally symmetric bodies about the fiber centroids; the quotient gauges and primal minimum are well defined and attained; the good-label construction, halfspace domination, and residual-rank estimate yield (18)-(19) with the stated constants, including the zero-measure case. Fenchel duality gives exactly (21), with the affine annihilator, quotient identification, compact feasibility, and zero-dimensional case all handled. The endpoint collapse preserves loop multiplicities and the support-function factors in (23)-(24). The reflected endpoint selections lie in the required half-metronoids, realize the dual objective with the correct factor, and accepted fact ff5bc0ba02cc86cd applies directly to prove (30) and mixed-integer support. No unsupported identification with the terminal off-diagonal capacity is made.
